description: This file contains various Jetpack Compose UI components for a finance tracker app, including top app bar, transaction table, summary bar, action buttons, and a transaction dialog.

methods.name: MonthTopAppBar
methods.description: Displays a top app bar with navigation arrows for changing the displayed month and shows the current month.

methods.name: TransactionsTable
methods.description: Renders a table of transactions with date, description, and amount, styled with Material3 components.

methods.name: SummaryBar
methods.description: Displays income, expenses, and net balance summaries with color coding.

methods.name: AddTransactionButtons
methods.description: Provides floating action buttons to add income or expense transactions.

methods.name: AddTransactionDialog
methods.description: Shows a dialog to input a new transaction's date, description, and amount, with confirm and cancel options.
